seoPage.metaDescription: Public EV Charging Guide for India — Planning, Not Promises — practical charging guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: Public charging is improving but uneven. Use this guide to plan backup and highway legs without assuming every neighbourhood has reliable DC today.

editorialSections.title: What public charging is for
paragraphs: Think of public networks as trip insurance and apartment backup — not always a full replacement for home AC.

editorialSections.title: Planning a session
bullets: Use apps to check live status — stations can be busy or offline.
Carry the right connector/adapters your model supports.
Plan buffer time on highway days — charging plus queueing.

editorialSections.title: Limitations to accept
paragraphs: Rural corridors and smaller cities may still have gaps — verify routes before a long family trip.

faq.question: Can I rely only on public charging?
faq.answer: Some owners do in cities — it requires patience and app discipline.

faq.question: How do I find chargers?
faq.answer: Use major network apps and plan alternative stops on highways.

faq.question: Payment failures?
faq.answer: Keep a backup app/account and avoid last-km range margins.

faq.question: Apartment backup?
faq.answer: Pair with society charging talks — see apartment setup guide.

faq.question: Compare?
faq.answer: Compare DC peak kW and connector on shortlisted models.
